c74object.name: el.rotapan~
c74object.description:
el.rotapan~ is a multi-channel circular rotation panner that rotates an entire multi-channel audio field across an equal number of speaker outputs (from 2 to 1024 channels). Unlike el.npan~ (which pans a single mono input across an array of speakers), el.rotapan~ preserves the relative spatial relationships among all incoming audio channels and rotates the entire multi-channel soundfield continuously using equal-power crossfading. Rotation is controlled at audio rate by a signal in the rightmost inlet ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with seamless circular wrapping.
Inlets
Inlets 1 to N (signal): Audio input channels 1 through N (total channels determined by the object argument, default: 2).
Rightmost Inlet [Inlet N+1] (signal): Pan rotation controller (0.0 to 1.0). Controls the circular rotation offset of the entire multichannel field around the speaker array. Values wrap smoothly and circularly.
Outlets
Outlets 1 to N (signal): Rotated audio output channels 1 through N.

inlet.description: Incoming audio signals to be spatially rotated.
Normalized audio-rate signal controlling circular rotation position around the speaker ring (0.0 to 1.0). Values wrap continuously around the array.

objarg.name: channel-count
objarg.description: The number of audio input and output channels in the circular array (default: 2, range: 2 to 1024).

method.name: signal
method.digest: Audio inputs or rotation control signal
method.description: Signals arriving at inlets 1 through N are the multi-channel audio to be rotated. The signal arriving at the rightmost inlet continuously modulates the circular rotation offset at audio rate.
